9|

11|

17|

24| def search_podcasts(query):
25|     """ Search for podcasts according to 'query' """
26| 
27|     logger.debug('Searching for "{query}" podcasts"', query=query)
28| 
29|     query = SearchQuery(query)
30| 
31|     results = (
32|         Podcast.objects.annotate(rank=SearchRank(F('search_vector'), query))
33|         .annotate(
34|             order=ExpressionWrapper(
35|                 F('rank') * F('subscribers'), output_field=FloatField()
36|             )
37|         )
38|         .filter(rank__gte=SEARCH_CUTOFF)
39|         .order_by('-order')
40|     )
41| 
42|     logger.debug(
43|         'Found {count} podcasts for "{query}"', count=len(results), query=query
44|     )
45| 
46|     return results
